name: Fliparchy
author: sclemance
description: Convertible tablet support: keeps iio-hyprland (auto screen/touch rotation) and squeekboard (on-screen keyboard) running, with bar toggles for the on-screen keyboard (shown only while the hardware tablet-mode switch is engaged) and a rotation lock. Requires iio-hyprland, squeekboard and evtest.

barWidget.description: Toggle the on-screen keyboard and rotation lock; only visible in tablet mode or while rotation is locked
